text:
Aisha: Originating RC for cascade GC tuning (rc-cascade-6112). Holding a 25m quiet window. Need QE + RM quick ack before canary.

deploy-bot: Candidate created: rc-cascade-6112 | image: registry.redwood/serve:sha256:77aa99bb | pinned=true | To start canary: `/deploy promote rc-cascade-6112 --to=canary --traffic=5%`.

Ben: Acked. Kicking off minimal smoke + functional checks (10 queries + datastore sanity). ETA ~8m.

Clara: Infra prechecks: nodepool has capacity, PV mounts ok, autoscaler quotas reserved. KV warm scheduled +90s after canary start.

Ben: Smoke: PASS. 10 queries, no errors. Observed small p50 drop. sample logs: `200 OK` across canary pods.

Aisha: Canary plan: route 5% initially, watch 12m. If stable ramp to 25% over 10m. Abort conditions: sustained 3m error rate > 0.6% OR p95 > 200ms absolute. Include rollback snippet in release notes.

RM-June: RM conditional signoff: I will approve staged promotion after 25% stays stable for 20m and quality evals show no regression. Paste rollback command before full lift.

deploy-bot: Action queued: `/deploy start rc-cascade-6112 --traffic=5% --kv-warm=true`

Ben: Putting rollback/playbook here for visibility:
```
# rollback to last stable
/deploy rollback promo-6112001 --to=stable
# unpin candidate image
/gcr unpin registry.redwood/serve:sha256:77aa99bb
# clear kv prefetch tag
/k8s patch daemonset cascade-service -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"kv-prefetch":"false"}}}}}'
```

SRE-Bot: Quiet window engaged for 25m. Non-critical alerts suppressed; critical will still page.

Clara: Observability link -> https://dashboards.internal/rc/6112 ; probes running.

Ben: 14m update: 5% canary stable. No errors, latency stable. Proceeding to ramp.

Aisha: Starting staged ramp: `/deploy promote rc-cascade-6112 --to=prod --staged "25%:10m" --note "cascade GC tuning"`
deploy-bot: Promotion started. Promo ID: promo-6112001. Monitor: `/deploy status promo-6112001`. Expected finish ts ~6112234100.

Clara: Telemetry: CPU/RSS normal, GC pause distributions improved. No SLO alerts.

Ben: 30m update: 25% stable for 20m, quality evals pass sampling.

RM-June: Final signoff: RM approves staged promotion complete. Proceed to full lift in next change window and publish release notes. Ensure rollback snippet is included under 'ops playbook'.

Aisha: Will publish release notes: "Cascade GC tuning; improved p50/p95 for small docs; KV prefetch enabled for warm paths." Scheduling full lift in next maintenance window. Thanks team.
